title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: declarative agents ground answers in scanned PDFs from SharePoint
summary: Hold: the usage-based licensing route omits prerequisites that determine whether users can retrieve SharePoint knowledge. Microsoft requires an Azure subscription and billing policy, with the policy connected to the SharePoint agents service and users in its assigned security group. The roadmap facts and both documented control paths and calls are supported.
